items.briefing:
Microsoft has released emergency security patches following this month's major update cycle, so it's important that all staff check their Windows devices are fully up to date. Separately, a low-cost hacking tool called VectraRAT is now available to cybercriminals for as little as $250 per month, making it easier than ever for attackers to target organisations like ours. Cisco has also patched a serious flaw in its email security product that was already being actively exploited.

Closer to home, a recent survey highlights that password sharing remains the most common security lapse among IT professionals — a good reminder that passwords should never be shared with colleagues, even for convenience.

**Practical tip:** If you're sharing a password with a colleague for any reason, stop and contact IT — they can set up proper access without creating a security risk.

featured.title: UTS picks Nexon for AUD $20 million network overhaul
featured.summary: The university's campus-wide upgrade will bring Wi-Fi 7 and AI-ready security to more than 18 months of work across every site.
